title: "W08_task1"
format: html
---



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(USAboundaries)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
lower48 <- state.name[!state.name %in% c("Alaska", "Hawaii")]

states_48 <- us_states() %>% 
  filter(name %in% lower48)

idaho_counties <- us_counties() %>% 
  filter(state_name == "Idaho")

View(idaho_counties)
```

```{r}
top_cities <- us_cities() %>% 
  filter(state_name %in% lower48) %>% 
  group_by(state_name) %>% 
  arrange(desc(population), .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
  slice(1:3) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  mutate(pop_thousands = population / 1000) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(rank = factor(rank))

coords <- st_coordinates(top_cities)

top_cities <- top_cities %>% 
  mutate(x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2])

View(top_cities)

city_labels <- top_cities %>% 
  filter(rank == 1)
```

```{r}
city_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states_48, fill = NA, color = "gray45", linewidth = .5) +
  geom_sf(data = idaho_counties, fill = NA, color = "gray35", linewidth = .35) +
  geom_sf(data = top_cities, aes(size = pop_thousands, color = rank), alpha = .9) +
  geom_label_repel(data = city_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = city), size = 2.2, color = "blue", fill = "white", label.size = .25,
    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = .3, point.padding = .2, segment.size = .25) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "darkblue", "2" = "dodgerblue", "3" = "lightblue"), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Population\n(1,000)", breaks = c(2000, 4000, 6000, 8000), range = c(1.5, 7)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-125, -66), ylim = c(24, 50), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Top 3 Largest Cities in Each of the 48 Contiguous States") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = .5), legend.position = "right")

city_map
```

```{r}
ggsave("top_3_cities_map.png", city_map, width = 15, height = 10)
```
